sum_width_certificates.proof: All initial states zero; leak is monotone ceil(beta U/256); independent per-neuron currents are bounded by sums of positive/negative weights; exact reset hull is propagated and intersected with independently checked invariants.
sum_width_certificates.caution: Specialized widths change the caller contract. Prior exhaustive full-word U11 tests do not authorize narrowing under that original generic contract. Hardware savings remain analytic and need a new bounded-domain RTL trial.
sum_width_certificates.conclusion: Use certified sum width and high-base width fairly in both adaptive and strongest fixed controls before selecting a precision-cliff hardware experiment.

adex_component_screen.conclusion: V-only eligibility can be unsafe for the intrinsic intermediate; current exact integer core applies only after a declared numeric contract. Observed float ranges do not certify integer widths.
adex_component_screen.scope: Published eight independent single-neuron parameter cases, unchanged Euler dynamics; no runtime Brian2 validation, training/classification, integer accuracy, packed group speed, hardware or energy claim.

current_width_screen.formula: Eight radix32 residue fields with guard; full base requires max(Ubits,Ibits)-4 signed bits; U8-tail base requires max(8,Ibits)-4. Fivefull+threetail saves3*max(Ubits-max(8,Ibits),0) explicit FFs against full8.
current_width_screen.conclusion: When Ibits>=Ubits, narrowing only U saves no high-base metadata. The current signed4 narrow metadata is not legal for a wider current. A real benchmark must prove I8 or use a new equally controlled exact design.
